title: Kere’ach (the Bald One)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Bekhorot 58a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.58a.15) Ben Azzai said: “All the sages of Israel seem to me like a garlic peel, except this bald one” (that is, Rabbi Akiva, according to [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bekhorot.58a.15.1); see also [Tosafot](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Bekhorot.58a.15.1)).[^1]

notes.text: Rashi identifies the bald one as Rabbi Akiva. Tosafot questions the associated genealogy and chronology and reports other explanations, including Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya and a personal name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3058&lang=en) lists the different explanations.
